title: Monitorar Uso de CPU, RAM e Disco
cmd: for($i=1; $i -le 5; $i++) { $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average; $ram = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $ramPct = [math]::Round((($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize - $ram.FreePhysicalMemory) / $ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize) * 100, 1); $disk = Get-PSDrive C; $diskPct = [math]::Round(($disk.Used / ($disk.Used + $disk.Free)) * 100, 1); Write-Host "[$i] CPU: $cpu% | RAM: $ramPct% | Disco: $diskPct%" -ForegroundColor $(if($cpu -gt 80 -or $ramPct -gt 80){'Red'}else{'Green'}); Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 }

$reportDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Relatorios"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $reportFile = Join-Path $reportDir "relatorio-$date.html"; $os = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $ram = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $totalRam = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); $disk = Get-PSDrive C; $html = @" Relatório do Sistema

Informações Gerais

cmd: icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /grant "{{NOME_USUARIO}}:(RX)"; Write-Host "✅ Permissão de leitura + execução concedida a {{NOME_USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

title: Desativar Herança de Permissões
cmd: icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /inheritance:d; Write-Host '✅ Herança desativada - permissões copiadas' -ForegroundColor Green

title: Ativar Herança de Permissões
cmd: icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /inheritance:e; Write-Host '✅ Herança ativada' -ForegroundColor Green

title: Alterar Proprietário para Administradores
cmd: takeown /f "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /a; icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /grant Administradores:(F); Write-Host '✅ Proprietário alterado para Administradores' -ForegroundColor Green

title: Listar Arquivos Sem Dono (Orphaned ACLs)
cmd: Get-ChildItem "{{DIRETORIO_ALVO}}" -Recurse -File -EA 0 | ForEach-Object { try { $acl = Get-Acl $_.FullName -EA 0; if ($acl.Owner -match 'S-1-5') { [PSCustomObject]@{Arquivo=$_.FullName; Owner=$acl.Owner} } } catch {} } | Format-Table -AutoSize

title: Testar HTTPS de um Site
cmd: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "{{URL_TESTE}}" -Method Head -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host 'Status:' $r.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Certificado válido' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host 'Erro:' $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red }

title: Instalar Ferramenta .NET (Global)
cmd: dotnet tool install --global {{PACOTE}}; Write-Host "✅ Ferramenta .NET {{PACOTE}} instalada!" -ForegroundColor Green

title: Desinstalar Ferramenta .NET (Global)
cmd: dotnet tool uninstall --global {{PACOTE}}; Write-Host "✅ Ferramenta .NET {{PACOTE}} desinstalada!" -ForegroundColor Green

title: Instalar Pacote via WinGet (por ID)
cmd: winget install --id {{PACOTE_ID}} --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Pacote {{PACOTE_ID}} instalado!" -ForegroundColor Green

title: Instalar Pacote via Chocolatey
cmd: choco install {{PACOTE}} -y; Write-Host "✅ Pacote {{PACOTE}} instalado via Chocolatey!" -ForegroundColor Green
